name: cap-formulate-recipe
description: Formulates a brewing recipe for a target style, volume and ABV: parses the brief, retrieves technique from the library, proposes a grain bill and hop schedule from the brew.ingredients catalogue, then computes OG/FG/ABV/IBU/SRM in SQL and saves it. The model never does the arithmetic.

value.vars_json: ={{ JSON.stringify({ question: $('When Executed by Another Workflow').first().json.question }) }}
value.schema_json: ={{ JSON.stringify({ type:"object", properties:{ style:{type:"string"}, batch_size_l:{type:"number"}, target_abv_pct:{type:"number"}, descriptors:{type:"array",items:{type:"string"} }, must_include:{type:"array",items:{type:"string"} }, avoid:{type:"array",items:{type:"string"} } }, required:["style","batch_size_l","target_abv_pct","descriptors","must_include","avoid"] }) }}

value.vars_json: ={{ JSON.stringify({ question: $json.question, spec: JSON.stringify({ style: $json.style, batch_size_l: $json.batch_size_l, target_abv_pct: $json.target_abv_pct, descriptors: $json.descriptors, must_include: $json.must_include, avoid: $json.avoid }), catalogue: $json.catalogue, passages: $json.passages || 'none' }) }}
value.schema_json: ={{ JSON.stringify({ type:"object", properties:{ items:{type:"array", items:{type:"object", properties:{ ingredient_id:{type:"number"}, stage:{type:"string"}, qty_g:{type:"number"}, timing_min:{type:"number"}, notes:{type:"string"} }, required:["ingredient_id","stage","qty_g"] } }, mash_temp_c:{type:"number"}, attenuation:{type:"number"}, not_available:{type:"array",items:{type:"string"} }, rationale:{type:"string"} }, required:["items","mash_temp_c","attenuation"] }) }}

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('Validate proposal').first().json.recipe_name, $('Validate proposal').first().json.batch_size_l, JSON.stringify($json.fit.items), $('Validate proposal').first().json.attenuation, $('Validate proposal').first().json.boil_volume_l, JSON.stringify({ mash_temp_c: $('Validate proposal').first().json.mash_temp_c }), $('Validate proposal').first().json.question ] }}

value.vars_json: ={{ JSON.stringify({ question: $json.question, recipe: $json.recipe, computed: $json.computed, sources: $json.sources, gaps: $json.gaps }) }}
